data.long_meaning: Joelias is a Hebrew name meaning 'God is Jehovah'. In the Old Testament, Joel was a prophet who foretold the coming of God's Spirit. The name has been in use throughout Christian history and is given to boys as a nod to this biblical figure. The name Joelias carries the meaning “God is Jehovah” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Joelias usually hope their child will grow to embody god is jehovah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
